category_title: Students exhibiting aggressive behaviors and elopement during non-preferred academic tasks
scenario_title: Typical academic tasks under low attention conditions
minimal_context: Ann is assigned a counting worksheet at her desk while the tutor sits at least 6 feet away across the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Ann, it is time to do your counting worksheet. Please get started on the first problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the paper without moving for over 5 seconds) Come over here right now! You have to sit next to me!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to sit over here at my desk right now. You can do the worksheet by yourself.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up, leaving contact with her designated chair) No! I'm not doing it!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Ann, please sit back down and finish your counting.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Yells loudly, throws her pencil across the room, and runs out of the classroom door) I'm leaving!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Ann, it is time to do your counting worksheet. Please get started on the first problem.

STUDENT: (Stares at the paper without moving for over 5 seconds) Come over here right now! You have to sit next to me!

TUTOR: I am going to sit over here at my desk right now. You can do the worksheet by yourself.

STUDENT: (Stands up, leaving contact with her designated chair) No! I'm not doing it!

TUTOR: Ann, please sit back down and finish your counting.

STUDENT: (Yells loudly, throws her pencil across the room, and runs out of the classroom door) I'm leaving!

task.content: typical academic tasks which were similar in response requirements

context.social_setting: staff member, seated at least 6 feet away

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Low attention conditions were those in which the staff member, seated at least 6 feet away, gave praise statements for on-task behavior only very rarely (i.e., once every 5 minutes).
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Leaving assigned area, talking out, and inappropriate staff interactions (ordering, yelling)

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: failure to comply with instruction within 5 seconds
